results.title: Eigenspace of fg maps into the eigenspace of gf
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: `g` sends the `μ`-eigenspace of `f ∘ₗ g` into the `μ`-eigenspace of `g ∘ₗ f`: if `(f ∘ₗ g) x = μ • x` then `(g ∘ₗ f) (g x) = μ • (g x)`.

results.title: Injectivity of g between eigenspaces of fg and gf
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: The map `g` restricted to the eigenspaces is injective when `μ ≠ 0`: if `g x = 0` for an eigenvector `x` of `f ∘ₗ g`, then `(f ∘ₗ g) x = 0 = μ • x`, so `x = 0`.

results.title: Surjectivity of g between eigenspaces of fg and gf
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: The map `g` restricted to the eigenspaces is surjective when `μ ≠ 0`: an eigenvector `y` of `g ∘ₗ f` is the image of `μ⁻¹ • f y`.

results.title: Linear equivalence of eigenspaces of fg and gf
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For a nonzero eigenvalue, the eigenspaces of `f ∘ₗ g` and of `g ∘ₗ f` are linearly equivalent, via `g` in one direction.

results.title: Geometric multiplicities of fg and gf agree
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: The geometric multiplicities of a nonzero eigenvalue of `f ∘ₗ g` and of `g ∘ₗ f` agree.

results.title: Eigenvectors of fg map to eigenvectors of gf
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: An eigenvector of `f ∘ₗ g` for a nonzero eigenvalue is sent by `g` to an eigenvector of `g ∘ₗ f` for the same eigenvalue.

results.title: Nonzero eigenvalues of fg and gf coincide
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: A nonzero scalar is an eigenvalue of `f ∘ₗ g` iff it is an eigenvalue of `g ∘ₗ f`.

results.title: Generalized eigenspace of fg maps into that of gf
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: `g` sends the generalized `μ`-eigenspace of `f ∘ₗ g` into the generalized `μ`-eigenspace of `g ∘ₗ f`, for every exponent. This is the intertwining `(g ∘ₗ f) ∘ₗ g = g ∘ₗ (f ∘ₗ g)` applied to Mathlib's `Module.End.mapsTo_genEigenspace_of_comp`.

results.title: Kernel of g meets a generalized eigenspace of fg trivially
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: If `g x = 0` and `x` lies in the generalized `μ`-eigenspace of `f ∘ₗ g` with `μ ≠ 0`, then `x = 0`. Indeed, on the kernel of `g` the map `f ∘ₗ g` vanishes, so `(f ∘ₗ g - μ • 1) ^ l` acts as `(-μ) ^ l • 1` there.

results.title: Injectivity of g on generalized eigenspaces of fg
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: The restriction of `g` to a generalized `μ`-eigenspace with `μ ≠ 0` is injective.

results.title: Generalized eigenspaces of fg and gf are finite-dimensional together
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For a nonzero scalar, the generalized eigenspaces of `f ∘ₗ g` and of `g ∘ₗ f` are finite-dimensional together, for every exponent `k : ℕ∞`.

results.title: Generalized eigenspaces of fg and gf have equal dimension
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: The generalized `μ`-eigenspaces of `f ∘ₗ g` and of `g ∘ₗ f` have equal `Module.finrank`, for every exponent `k : ℕ∞` and every nonzero `μ`. They are finite-dimensional together; if both are infinite-dimensional, both finranks are zero. In finite dimension only the stabilized generalized eigenspace (for example at exponent `⊤`) measures algebraic multiplicity.

results.title: Monochromatic arithmetic progression
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Let $c$ be a colouring of the natural numbers with the two colours true and false, let $b$ be a colour and let $l, N$ be natural numbers. Then $c$ has a monochromatic progression of colour $b$ and length $l$ in $\{1, \dots, N\}$ when there are natural numbers $a \ge 1$ and $d \ge 1$ with $a + (l - 1) d \le N$, where $l - 1$ is read as $0$ when $l = 0$, such that $c(a + j d) = b$ for every $j < l$.

results.title: The off-diagonal van der Waerden numbers are not polynomially bounded
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: There are no natural numbers $C$ and $A$ such that for every $k \ge 1$, every colouring of the natural numbers in red and blue has a red $3$-term or a blue $k$-term arithmetic progression $a, a + d, \dots$ with $a \ge 1$, $d \ge 1$ and all terms in $\{1, \dots, C k^A\}$.

results.title: Monochromatic arithmetic progressions in an initial interval
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Let $c$ be a red/blue colouring of the natural numbers, given as a map to the Booleans ($\mathrm{true}$ is red, $\mathrm{false}$ is blue), let $b$ be a colour and let $\ell$ and $N$ be natural numbers. Then $c$ has an $\ell$-term arithmetic progression of colour $b$ inside $\{1, \dots, N\}$ if there are natural numbers $a$ and $d > 0$ such that for every $i < \ell$ we have $1 \le a + id \le N$ and $c(a + id) = b$.

results.title: Ordered embedding
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Let $\lt _H$ be a strict total order on $\{0, \dots, n - 1\}$. A map $f \colon \{0, \dots, n - 1\} \to \{0, \dots, N - 1\}$ is an ordered embedding when it is injective and $a \lt _H b$ implies $f(a) < f(b)$ for all $a$ and $b$, where $\{0, \dots, N - 1\}$ carries its natural order.

results.summary: Membership in the inner edge set is membership in the image of the edge map.

results.title: Glued configuration takes the inner value on inner edges
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The glued configuration takes the inner value on inner edges.

results.title: Glued configuration equals the outer one at each non-inner edge
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The glued configuration takes the outer value off the inner edges.

results.title: Glued value on $\{\iota x, \iota y\}$ is the inner value on $\{x, y\}$
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The glued configuration on `{ι x, ι y}` is the inner value on `{x, y}`.

reading_title.source: Glued value on $\{\iota x, \iota y\}$ is the inner value on $\{x, y\}$

results.title: Restricting a glued configuration recovers the inner one
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Restricting a glued configuration recovers the inner configuration.

results.title: Glued configuration agrees with the outer one off the inner edge set
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: A glued configuration agrees with the outer configuration off the inner edges.

results.title: Agreeing configuration is the gluing of its own restriction
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: A configuration that agrees with `ψ` off the inner edges is the gluing of `ψ` with its own restriction.

results.title: Conditioning fibre is the set of gluings
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The configurations agreeing with `ψ` off the inner edges are exactly the gluings of `ψ` with inner configurations.

results.title: Graph of open non-inner edges
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The graph of `ψ`-open edges of `G_out` that are not inner edges.

results.title: Outside graph with the wired boundary clique
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The outside graph: `ψ`-open non-inner edges together with the clique on the wired boundary `∂_out`.

results.title: Outside-graph adjacency: open non-inner edge or boundary pair
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Adjacency in the outside graph.

results.title: Wiring induced on the inner graph
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The wiring induced on `G_in` by `ψ`: distinct inner vertices are adjacent when their images are joined in the outside graph.

results.title: Induced-wiring adjacency: distinct and joined in the outside graph
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Adjacency in the induced wiring.

results.title: Image of the inner open subgraph in the outer graph
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The image in `G_out` of the open subgraph of an inner configuration `ω`.

results.title: Inner cluster graph with the induced wiring
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The inner cluster graph: open edges of `ω` together with the induced wiring.

results.title: Cluster graph of a glued configuration
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The cluster graph of the glued configuration on `G_out` with the wired boundary clique.

results.title: Outside graph is a subgraph of the full cluster graph
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The outside graph is a subgraph of the full cluster graph.

results.title: Glued configuration on inner edges ignores the outer configuration
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: On inner edges the glued configuration does not depend on the outer configuration.

results.title: Full cluster graph as the union of inner image and outside graphs
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The full cluster graph is the union of the inner image graph and the outside graph.

results.title: Endpoints of inner image edges are inner vertices
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Both endpoints of an inner image edge are inner vertices.

results.title: Inner image graph on embedded vertices is the open subgraph
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The inner image graph on images of `ι` is the open subgraph of `ω`.

results.title: Outside reachability gives inner cluster reachability
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Inner vertices whose images are joined in the outside graph are joined in the inner cluster graph.

results.title: Inner cluster reachability gives full-graph reachability of images
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Reachability in the inner cluster graph gives reachability of the images in the full cluster graph.

results.title: Full-graph reachability of images gives inner cluster reachability
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Reachability of images in the full cluster graph gives reachability in the inner cluster graph.

results.title: Full-graph and inner cluster reachability agree on embedded vertices
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Images of inner vertices are joined in the full cluster graph iff the vertices are joined in the inner cluster graph.

results.title: Full-graph edges at non-inner vertices are outside-graph edges
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: A full cluster graph edge at a non-inner vertex is an outside graph edge.

results.title: Outside-only vertex
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: A vertex is outside-only if its outside cluster contains no inner vertex.

results.title: Outside-only vertices are not inner
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: An outside-only vertex is not inner.

results.title: Outside-only property is constant on outside clusters
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Being outside-only is constant on outside clusters.

results.title: Full-graph reachability from an outside-only vertex stays outside
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: From an outside-only vertex, reachability in the full cluster graph stays in the outside graph.

results.title: Outside-only property of an outside cluster
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The outside-only property of a cluster of the outside graph.

results.title: Cluster of a vertex is outside-only iff the vertex is
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The cluster of `v` is outside-only iff `v` is.

results.title: Outside-only clusters
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The outside clusters that contain no inner vertex.

results.title: Cluster map into the clusters of a glued configuration
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The map from inner clusters and outside-only clusters to the clusters of the glued configuration.

results.title: Cluster map sends the inner cluster of $x$ to that of $\iota x$
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The cluster map sends the inner cluster of `x` to the full cluster of `ι x`.

results.title: Cluster map sends an outside-only cluster of $v$ to that of $v$
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The cluster map sends an outside-only cluster of `v` to the full cluster of `v`.

reading_title.source: Cluster map sends an outside-only cluster of $v$ to that of $v$

results.title: Injectivity of the cluster map
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The cluster map is injective.

results.title: Surjectivity of the cluster map
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The cluster map is surjective.

results.title: Cluster bijection for a glued configuration
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The clusters of the glued configuration are in bijection with the inner clusters plus the outside-only clusters.

results.title: Number of outside-only clusters
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The number of outside-only clusters of `ψ`.

results.title: Glued cluster count is induced-wiring count plus outside-only clusters
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The wired cluster count of a glued configuration is the induced-wiring cluster count of the inner configuration plus the number of outside-only clusters.

results.title: Edges of the inner graph map onto the inner edges of the outer graph
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The image of the edges of `G_in` is the set of inner edges of `G_out`.

results.title: Outer Bernoulli edge weight of a configuration
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The Bernoulli edge weight of `ψ` on the non-inner edges of `G_out`.

results.title: Positivity of the outer edge weight
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The outer edge weight is positive for `p ∈ (0, 1)`.

results.title: Factorization of the edge weight of a glued configuration
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The edge weight of a glued configuration factors into the inner edge weight and the outer edge weight.

results.title: Outer factor of the FK weight of a glued configuration
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The factor `ψ` contributes to the FK weight of a glued configuration: its outer edge weight times `q` to the number of outside-only clusters.

results.title: Positivity of the outer factor
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The outer factor is positive for `p ∈ (0, 1)` and `q > 0`.

results.title: Factorization of the wired FK weight of a glued configuration
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The wired FK weight of a glued configuration is the induced-wiring FK weight of the inner configuration times the outer factor.

results.title: Factorization of the conditioned outer partition function
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The partition function of the outer measure conditioned on `ψ` is the induced-wiring partition function times the outer factor.

results.title: Conditional outer measure is the induced-wiring FK measure
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Conditioned on `ψ` off the inner edges, the outer wired measure of a glued configuration is the induced-wiring FK measure of the inner configuration.

results.title: Conditional outer probability as an induced-wiring probability
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The conditional outer probability of an event is the induced-wiring probability of its pullback under gluing.

results.title: Domination by the inner wired measure under a coarser induced wiring
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: If the induced wiring is coarser than the clique on `∂_in`, the induced-wiring measure is dominated by the wired measure on `G_in` (for `q ≥ 1`).

results.title: Free inner measure is dominated by every induced-wiring measure
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The free FK measure on `G_in` is dominated by every induced-wiring measure (for `q ≥ 1`).

results.title: Free inner measure is dominated by the conditional outer measure
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The free FK measure on `G_in` is dominated by the restricted conditional outer measure (for `q ≥ 1`).

results.title: Projection closing every inner edge
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The projection of a configuration on `G_out` that closes every inner edge.

results.title: Projected configuration is closed on inner edges
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The projection closes inner edges.

results.title: Projection keeps non-inner edges
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The projection keeps non-inner edges.

results.title: Idempotence of the inner-edge projection
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The projection is idempotent.

results.title: Projection fibres are conditioning fibres
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The fibre of the projection over a projected configuration is its conditioning fibre.

results.title: Outer wired fibre masses sum to one
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The outer wired masses of the fibres over projected configurations sum to one.

results.title: Law of total probability over outside configurations
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Law of total probability for the outer wired measure over the configuration off the inner edges. See also `bcProb_fibre_decompose` in `FKDisjointBoxDomainMarkov` for a general conditioned edge set.

results.title: Conditional outer wired probability at most the inner wired one, $q \ge 1$
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Conditioned on `ψ`, the restricted outer wired probability of an increasing event is at most its wired probability on `G_in`, if the induced wiring is coarser than the clique on `∂_in`.

results.title: Inner wired domination of the restricted outer wired measure
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Domination of the restricted outer wired measure by the inner wired measure on increasing events, when every induced wiring is coarser than the clique on `∂_in` (for `q ≥ 1`).

results.title: Lattice inclusion matches induced adjacency
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The inclusion of a vertex set of `ℤ^d` into a larger one matches the induced hypercubic adjacency.

results.title: Inner vertex with an outside-graph edge lies on the inner boundary
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: An inner vertex joined to a non-inner vertex in the outside graph lies on the inner boundary.

results.title: Lattice induced wirings are coarser than the inner boundary clique
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: For sub-boxes of `ℤ^d` avoiding the outer boundary, every induced wiring is coarser than the clique on the inner boundary.

results.title: Inner wired domination for vertex sets of $\mathbb{Z}^d$
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: For a vertex set of `ℤ^d` inside a larger one and avoiding its wired boundary, the restricted outer wired FK measure is dominated by the inner wired FK measure on increasing events (for `q ≥ 1`).

results.title: Restriction pulls back all-open events to their images
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The pullback of "all edges of `t` are open" under restriction is "all edges of `ι(t)` are open".

results.title: Outer wired all-open probability at most the inner wired one
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: For a vertex set of `ℤ^d` inside a larger one and avoiding its wired boundary, the outer wired probability that all edges of `ι(t)` are open is at most the inner wired probability that all edges of `t` are open (for `q ≥ 1`).
